title: Add OAuth provider config
body: Load client id/secret + issuer from env and expose a typed config.
acceptance: `loadAuthConfig()` throws a clear error naming the variable when the issuer is missing (test)
outOfScope: token refresh, owned by the session ticket

title: Add session middleware
body: Verify the session cookie on each request and attach the user.
acceptance: a request without a valid session cookie to a protected route returns 401 (test)
a valid cookie attaches the user to the request (test)

title: Add /login and /callback routes
body: Start the OAuth flow and handle the redirect; set the session cookie.
acceptance: `/login` redirects to the provider and `/callback` sets the session cookie (test)
a full login round-trip yields an authenticated session (integration test)
